candidate.name: Telehouse London Docklands West Two
candidate.date_review: The operator publishes a July construction update for West Two. July lies wholly within the fixed window; the existing month-precision convention could represent this without inventing an exact work day. No lifecycle row is admitted while independent gates remain unresolved.
candidate.scope: West Two is not the existing West building, the April administration-building opening, or South levels 4/5. No separate site count is proposed for other campus buildings.

rights_review.finding: The full terms body is framed around the Marketplace, but its content clause also refers to information elsewhere on telehouse.net. The campus page itself links those terms. No open licence, written permission or demonstrated scope exception is established by these captures. Do not silently treat the Marketplace heading as cancelling the broader clause.
rights_review.independent_review: Bohr independently read the captured main terms and campus footer and concurred with the hold.
rights_review.redistribution_scope: Minimal source attribution, independent research decisions and capture metadata only; no publisher prose, code, imagery or PDF is redistributed.

locator_review.discovery: The official consultation listing links a compressed Site Condition Report. The search service returned cached PDF text, but the ordinary live download of that exact listed link redirected to unavailable-consultation HTML.
locator_review.filename_caveat: The temporary filename telehouse-scr.pdf reflects the requested URL, not the returned media type. It is HTML and is not parsed, rendered, pinned or claimed as a PDF.
locator_review.independent_review: Bohr independently checked file signature, complete response-body hash, HTTP metadata and visible unavailable message.

The listed BATOT link returned Consultation Unavailable in web view.
locator_review.stop_rule: No repeated restricted-route requests, alternate-client access workaround, or cached-text-to-raw-PDF hash substitution.

prior_hold_preservation.scope: New review only; old month/day and locator decisions remain historical records.

next_action: Use a separately authorised physical-status source or resolved reuse basis plus a genuinely accessible exact-campus locator. Do not retry unavailable government files or replace the campus with an office/postcode point.
